description: Update fields on an existing contact or company. Only the fields you pass change; omitted fields are left alone. Multi-value fields (email, phone, address, website) are REPLACED by the list you pass. Set is_company=true when renaming a company. LACRM: EditContact.

company_name.description: For a PERSON: the company they work at (created if it does not exist). Not used for company records.

contact_id.description: The contact or company id (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

custom_fields.description: Extra fields keyed by the account's field names exactly as LACRM shows them (e.g. {"Lead Source": "Referral"}). Use lacrm_list_custom_fields to find them. Merged verbatim into Parameters.

text.description: The value, e.g. an email address or phone number.

type.description: Type label, e.g. Work, Personal, Mobile. Must match a type in the CRM.

is_company.description: Set true if this record is a company, so `name` maps to its Company Name field.

name.description: New full name (person) or company name.

text.description: The value, e.g. an email address or phone number.

type.description: Type label, e.g. Work, Personal, Mobile. Must match a type in the CRM.

name: lacrm_edit_contact
title: Edit a contact or company
